Base Rates

Methodology

  • Universe — SPY daily closes (dividends excluded), 2010-01-04 to 2026-10-16.
  • De-duplication — Signals clustered: after a signal fires, the next 63 trading days are skipped so each episode counts once. Only signals with a full forward window are counted.
  • Reading the cards — the big number is the median forward return after the setup fired, not the average; medians aren't dragged around by outliers. "Positive % of the time" is the hit rate.
  • What this is not — base rates are starting points, not predictions. Small samples (n under ~10) are suggestive, not conclusive. Past odds describe the past.

Source: Twelve Data (daily bars). Computed at build time; refresh with npm run base-rates.
